description: This file defines a DeviceAuthService class that manages device authorization flow, including initiating authorization, polling for status updates, handling success, denial, expiration, errors, and cleanup. It uses EventEmitter for event-driven communication and interacts with external API endpoints.

classes.name: DeviceAuthService
classes.description: A service class for handling device authorization flow, including initiation, polling, and cleanup.

methods.name: initiate
methods.description: Starts the device authorization process by requesting a code from the API, validates response, emits 'started' event, and begins polling.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Polls the API for the current status of device authorization, handles different response statuses, and emits corresponding events.

methods.name: startPolling
methods.description: Begins periodic polling at a set interval and performs an immediate poll.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the device authorization process, stops polling, and emits 'cancelled'.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops polling, and removes event listeners.
